business_problem: ArcelorMittal needed to unify scattered quality data across global factories to reduce defects, cut costs, and ensure customer satisfaction in a complex steel production process.
solution_summary: ArcelorMittal needed to unify scattered quality data across global factories to reduce defects, cut costs, and ensure customer satisfaction in a complex steel production process. ArcelorMittal chose MongoDB Atlas on Azure to power E-GPQS, enabling scalable, low-maintenance data processing of 2.5TB/year with fast setup, flexibility, and high availability. Saving time and improving efficiency With ArcelorMittal now able to view critical data in one central location, it can gain essential insights into production and tackle complex data-correlation tasks that enable process improvement. ArcelorMittal has also developed a series of new dashboards and associated key performance indicators that enable wider analysis both at plant level and across the wider production chain to enable larger-scale studies. “It makes sense to not just focus on the production level, and this central database allows me to go beyond that,” Xavier explains.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the high-volume operational and event data that underpins ArcelorMittal's real-time analytics platform.

data_flow: Operational events, telemetry, or transaction data are ingested into MongoDB Atlas, enriched or filtered where needed, retained for fast query access, and served to analytics, monitoring, or customer-facing workflows in near real time. Upstream and downstream integrations include Azure, CRM systems, data lake.
